{{Top|leg}}
Long prior to the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a '''civilization''' existed on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Volgax]]. This society constructed large buildings on the planet but eventually died out, leaving their ruins behind. These facilities were later adopted by the [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] of [[The Crucible]] during the wars.
